before-shades-of-mort-ton-as-an-afflicte.npc: The serum it works...but it's not too fresh, make some yourself and then it might work for longer.

after-shades-of-mort-ton.npc: Ah, hello again, what can I do for you now?
Hello again! Many thanks for helping us to solve the  riddle with the Shades, we can start to work now  putting all those Shade spirits to rest and get  a little bit of a reward to go along with it!

using-serum-208-on-him.npc: Well done...I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it my friend!  I'd like to give you something for your trouble!

using-serum-208-on-him.text: If Shades of Mort'ton is ready to be completed:

steps.section: Talking to Ulsquire after burning shade remains

using-serum-208-on-him-using-serum-208-o.npc: You've already used the permanent serum on me, you don't need to use that any more.
